headDetails.title: Chill ＜＞＜ | Digital Sanctuary in VRChat
headDetails.description: A VRChat community focused on serenity, low-energy social interaction, and visual comfort across PC & Android.

hero.title: Chill
hero.vrClarification: No VR headset required • Accessible via desktop PC, Android mobile, or VR headsets
hero.subtitle: A sanctuary to rest, unwind, and chat quietly inside virtual worlds.
hero.description: A community-led social club in VRChat designed to step away from digital sensory overload, listen to calm music, and share cozy conversations in comforting spaces.

overview.label: 01 — The Experience
overview.title: A Sanctuary Built for Peace
overview.subtitle: We create the ideal conditions for you to socialize at your own pace without sensory burnout.

cards.title: Cozy Worlds
cards.content: We curate spacious worlds with comfortable amenities: fireplace corners, beds, and resting spots where attendees naturally gather in small, dispersed circles.

cards.title: Calm Music & Visual Comfort
cards.content: Sessions are accompanied by soothing, non-energetic background tunes. We promote pleasant avatars that do not dazzle, blind, or disturb others.

cards.title: 100% PC & Android (No VR headset required)
cards.content: You can join directly with keyboard & mouse on standard PC, via your Android phone, or with any VR headset.

meetings.label: 02 — Weekly Gatherings
meetings.title: Schedules & How to Join
meetings.subtitle: We meet every Saturday across two international time slots adjusted to your local timezone.

steps.title: Join Group or Discord
steps.desc: Join our VRChat group and our Discord server to receive event announcements and world links.

steps.title: Check Your Schedule
steps.desc: Choose the EU or US session that fits your schedule, automatically converted to your local time below.

steps.title: Enter the Instance
steps.desc: Launch VRChat on PC or Android, go to Groups > Chill, and join the active instance.

meetings.groupPublicNote: Standard weekly meetups are hosted as Group Public, allowing anyone (even non-members) to join freely.
meetings.movieSpecialNote: Every 10 meetups (10th, 20th, 30th...), we host our special Movie Night in Group Plus mode.

values.label: 04 — Principles & Harmony
values.title: Our Core Sanctuary Pillars
values.description: We preserve instance harmony through simple guidelines rooted in mutual consideration.

pillars.title: Audio Discipline
pillars.text: Conversations are kept at a moderate, conversational tone. No microphone music or noise spam.

pillars.title: Visual Comfort
pillars.text: We encourage pleasant, non-obtrusive avatars. Blinding lights, flashing shaders, and massive particle systems are avoided.

pillars.title: Sanctuary Culture
pillars.text: Zero tolerance for toxicity, insults, or drama. A safe haven to rest, chat, and relax.

protocols.label: Instance Rules
protocols.title: VRChat Guidelines & Conduct
protocols.description: Clear expectations enforced during our openings to ensure everyone's well-being.

list.title: Conversational Tone
list.desc: Keep your voice at a comfortable volume. Avoid playing audio or music through your microphone.

list.title: Pleasant Avatars
list.desc: Wear avatars that are visually comfortable and free from dazzling or annoying visual effects.

list.title: Respect the Calm
list.desc: Zero toxicity, insults, or drama. We come here to disconnect peacefully.

list.title: No "Chaos" Roleplay
list.desc: Do not bring chaotic dynamics or invasive behaviors into our relaxation spaces.

list.title: T.O.S. Compliance
list.desc: Strict adherence to official VRChat Terms of Service at all times.

chaosLeft.title: Initial Chaos
chaosLeft.subtitle: Noise & Overload
chaosLeft.text: The natural drift of virtual spaces toward sensory overload: blinding avatar shaders, mic shouting, and uncontrolled stimuli.

structure.title: Structure (Chill)
structure.subtitle: Our Identity
structure.text: Voluntary moderation, conversational volume, and peaceful atmosphere. Chill embodies the ＞ force to protect calm.

chaosRight.title: Spontaneity
chaosRight.subtitle: Social Freedom
chaosRight.text: Organic human interaction re-emerges naturally. The goal is not suppression, but providing a safe harbor where connection can thrive.

structuredChaos.title: Balance
structuredChaos.subtitle: Structured Chaos
structuredChaos.text: The ideal state where fun and genuine friendships co-exist free from social exhaustion.

roleCard.title: Our Specific Role: The Structure Force ＞
roleCard.text: Within the FISH network, Chill does not seek chaotic roleplay. We are the architects of Structure (＞): the cozy retreat where any VRChat user can rest and recharge.

team.label: 06 — The Team
team.title: Sanctuary Staff
team.subtitle: The individuals who host, moderate, and maintain our chill environment.

members.name: Gabrielgsd
members.comment: I love the philosophy behind FISH ＜＞＜, but the chaos can sometimes be overwhelming. As a naturally calm person, I created Chill to embody the ＞ side: a space to enjoy our community in true peace.

members.name: KaMiKenZa
members.comment: I’m a part-time photographer, still learning with every photo I take. I believe anyone can be a photographer—because a photo is more than something beautiful; it tells a story through the eyes and feelings of the person behind the camera. I love capturing little moments, shared memories, and special events, so the people in those pictures can always stay close.<3

statistics.spatialNoteDesc: We do not artificially restrict attendance. We intentionally select spacious open worlds with distinct zones (bonfires, beds, terraces) so members can naturally gather into small, quiet sub-groups without audio interference.

vision.label: Our Philosophy
vision.title: Looking Forward
vision.quote: In a virtual world saturated with noise and hyper-stimulation, shared serenity is the most valuable harbor.
vision.text: Chill proves that by applying the right touch of structure (＞), we can cultivate spaces where calm and authentic connections always take precedence.
